query: SELECT p.lo AS "lo!", p.hi AS "hi!", GREATEST( similarity(a.normalized_title, b.normalized_title), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(similarity(x.normalized, b.normalized_title)) FROM series_titles x WHERE x.series_id = a.id), 0), COALESCE((SELECT MAX(similarity(y.normalized, a.normalized_title)) FROM series_titles y WHERE y.series_id = b.id), 0) ) AS "sim!" FROM UNNEST($1::uuid[], $2::uuid[]) AS p(lo, hi) JOIN series a ON a.id = p.lo JOIN series b ON b.id = p.hi
